resetConfiguration.confirm:
### {{icon.triangle-alert}} Reset leveling?
This resets the leveling settings, rewards and multipliers. Everyone keeps their XP and levels.
resetConfiguration.nothing: There's nothing to reset, leveling hasn't been set up here yet.
resetConfiguration.success: Leveling is reset. Use `/leveling-config settings` to set it up again.

general: Members get XP for one message a minute at most, so spamming doesn't help.
With level up messages off, members still level up and get their reward roles, just without a message.
winners: The weekly leaderboard starts over every Monday and the monthly one on the 1st, both at 00:00 UTC, even if the bot was offline then.
Without a winners channel, winners aren't announced.
With winner messages off, the leaderboards still start over and winners still get their role.
filters: A category covers every channel in it, and threads count as the channel they're in, for ignored and allowed channels alike.
rewards: Reward roles are also given to members who already reached the level.
The bot can only give roles below its own highest role.
channelMultipliers: A multiplier on a category counts for every channel in it.
When several multipliers apply, the highest one counts. They don't add up.
roleMultipliers: When several multipliers apply, the highest one counts. They don't add up.

This removes the counting game in this server **with all its stats**: runs, counted numbers and everyone's counts. This can't be undone.
resetConfiguration.nothing: There's nothing to reset, there's no counting game here yet.
resetConfiguration.success: The counting game and its stats are gone. Use `/counting-config setup` to start a new one.

tips: Nobody can count twice in a row. That's removed, but never costs a life.
Numbers sent while the bot was offline still count once it's back.
If the last number is deleted or changed, the bot posts it again, so nobody can quietly break the count.
Turned off, messages in the counting channel are left alone, and the ones sent meanwhile aren't checked once it's back on.
In a new counting channel, messages already there are left alone.

resetConfiguration.confirm:
### {{icon.triangle-alert}} Reset the log settings?
This resets the log channels, switches and ignore lists. What's already logged stays.
resetConfiguration.nothing: There's nothing to reset, logs haven't been set up here yet.
resetConfiguration.success: The log settings are reset. Use `/logs-config settings` to set them up again.

logs.tooLong: Too long to show in full here, the whole text is in the file below.

general: The bot needs View Audit Log to say who did something and why.
Ignoring a category ignores every channel in it.
Turned off, every group keeps its channel and switches, for when logs are turned back on.
messages: Edits and deletions of messages sent before the bot last restarted can't show what they said.
Messages of bots and webhooks aren't logged.
Long messages and bulk deletes come as a file you can read right in Discord.
members: The Copy IDs button on every entry is for phones, where text in messages can't be selected.
moderation: The reason a moderator gave is taken from the audit log, so it needs View Audit Log.
server: The Copy IDs button on every entry is for phones, where text in messages can't be selected.
voice: Channels left out under General are left out here too.

settings.title: ### {{icon.star}} Starboard Settings
settings.noChannel: Pick a channel below, and messages with enough reactions get posted there.

enabled.label: Starboard
enabled.description: Post messages with enough reactions on the starboard.

emoji.label: Emoji
emoji.description: The reaction that stars a message. A normal emoji, or one of this server's.
emoji.invalid: That's not an emoji I can use. Type a normal emoji, or the name of one of this server's emoji, like `:shiny:`.

threshold.label: Reactions Needed
threshold.description: How many stars it takes to get on the starboard, by reacting or with the button on the post.
threshold.invalid: Type a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.

ignoredChannels.label: Ignored Channels
ignoredChannels.description: Reactions in these channels, or in the channels of these categories, don't count.

post.own: You can't star your own message.
post.gone: This message isn't on the starboard anymore.
post.closed: Stars can't be changed right now, as the starboard is turned off or doesn't count this channel anymore.

resetConfiguration.confirm:
### {{icon.triangle-alert}} Reset the starboard settings?
This resets the channel, emoji, reactions needed and ignored channels. Posts already on the starboard stay, but aren't updated anymore.
resetConfiguration.nothing: There's nothing to reset, the starboard hasn't been set up here yet.
resetConfiguration.success: The starboard settings are reset. Use `/starboard-config settings` to set it up again.

tips: A post deleted by hand isn't posted again, however many stars it gets.
Age-restricted messages only go on a starboard that is age-restricted too.
The author's own star and bots' don't count.
Everyone counts once, whether they react, press the star on the post, or both. Pressing the star again takes their star back, also one given by reacting.
Posts follow the stars: the count updates, and the post goes when the message is deleted or falls below again.
